prompts.props: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production sprite atlas for a Unity 2D top-down old underground mine. Reference images provided are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY: match their restrained gray-brown/olive stone, cold blue-gray shadows, near-black 1 logical pixel contours, hand placed chunky facets, small amber light. Do not include characters. Output square 1024x1024 with EXACT uniform 4 columns x 4 rows, each cell 256 square, no gutters, no labels, NO text/grid lines/background/shadows outside sprites. Genuine transparent background. Each sprite centered with at least 24 px transparent margin inside its cell. Pixel art authored as though each cell is 64x64 logical pixels upscaled 4x nearest neighbor, crisp 4x4 square pixels, no antialiasing/blur/gradients/noise. Slightly overhead view with top and short front face, no isometric diamonds. Row1: small pebble cluster; medium rubble pile; broken angular stone shards; small iron ore lump. Row2: small blue crystal ore lump; coal lump cluster; dark navy magnetite lump; iron vein embedded in irregular gray rock patch. Row3: blue crystal vein embedded in rock patch; coal seam in rock patch; vertical timber mine support with rusty brackets; horizontal wooden support beam with rusty brackets. Row4: two loose weathered planks; broken wooden debris; closed wooden mine crate; small hooded mining lantern with tiny amber lit glass, no surrounding glow. Muted low contrast environmental props subordinate to characters. Every cell separate isolated complete sprite.
prompts.surfaces: Use case: stylized-concept. Production texture atlas ONLY for top down pixel art old underground mine Unity game, matching supplied stone monster and stone golem STYLE references. NO characters. Exact 4 columns x 2 rows filling square canvas, eight rectangular texture samples edge to edge with no gaps no borders no text. Row1 col1 muted gray-brown rough stone FLOOR; col2 dusty brown earth FLOOR; col3 slightly cold blue gray stone FLOOR; col4 worn gray-brown mine FLOOR with sparse shallow pick scratches. Row2 col1 chunky natural WALL rock mass; col2 protruding WALL rock slabs; col3 fractured WALL rock surface; col4 aged dark olive-gray WALL rock. IMPORTANT floors must be MUCH LOWER CONTRAST than walls: broad quiet flat midtone #55534A / #615A4B with small sparse clustered subtle facets, no black outlines on floor stones, no cobblestone pavements, no repeating grid, no giant cracks, no bright white flecks. Walls use #747064 olive gray-brown lit facets and #525E5E cold shadow faces, #303535 fissures, large irregular natural interlocking polygonal boulders; do not make brick wall. All 8 samples tile seamlessly in both axes; uniform lighting no vignette no cast shadows on borders no edge framing. True pixel art as if each sample is 64x64 logical px, crisp square pixel blocks, sparse intentional texture, not tiny noise. No smooth shading, no 3D, no photograph, no blur. Flat orthographic texture swatches, not rendered objects. All opaque, no transparency.
prompts.details: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE production sprite atlas for topdown pixel art old mine game matching provided gray-brown stone monster / stone golem STYLE REFERENCES ONLY. NO characters. EXACT 4x4 equal cell grid on square canvas, 16 isolated sprites, no grid lines/no text/no labels. Genuine transparent background. Every sprite contained within its cell with at least 25px margin. All drawn as 64x64 logical pixel art upscaled: near-black single logical pixel lines, flat deliberate angular color clusters, dark olive gray-brown stone #747064, cold blue-gray shadows #525E5E, no blur, no gradient, no noise. Orthographic overhead with short visible front rock face, no isometric. Row1: horizontal rough mine wall lower rim strip with dark foot shadow (wide and low); irregular rocky outer corner elbow rim facing lower right; irregular rocky inner corner elbow rim; shallow dark contact shadow strip (very low contrast narrow flat gray-brown silhouette). Row2: small branching thin floor crack (muted dark gray); shallow scraped worn floor patch (subtle gray-brown); pickaxe mining scratch gouges (subtle dark gray, clustered); sparse embedded gravel flat floor decal. Row3: large branching crack on irregular old wall rock patch; large iron vein with rusty copper-colored ore nodes embedded in wall rock; large blue crystal vein embedded in wall rock (limited muted blue highlights); ancient broken stone rubble slab with deep fissure. Row4: very low contrast irregular scuffed ground depression, NOT circular, NOT magic pattern, no bright marks; broken timber mine brace (a vertical post and broken diagonal beam); thin dark rock spine for a very narrow wall; irregular dark gray-brown rocky end cap for wall. Transparent space must remain transparent including between disconnected crack strokes. No glow aura/no explosion/no runes. Environmental detail must stay subordinate to game characters.
